{{Quote|I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan.|Mace Windu|audio=Windu-WhatJedi.flac|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Nicanas Tassu''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who became a [[Jedi Knight]] in the [[Jedi Order]] and was notable for his skill in [[Force jump]]ing. In [[22 BBY]], he was part of a [[Jedi assault team]] that [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] led to infiltrate the [[Petranaki Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] in order to [[First Battle of Geonosis|rescue]] the Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Tassu and the other [[Jedi]] revealed themselves when Windu confronted [[Count]] [[Dooku]], leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which had captured Kenobi, his [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].

Tassu located the trio of [[prisoner]]s on the arena floor as fighting broke out with Separatist [[battle droid]]s and provided the unarmed Skywalker with a spare [[lightsaber]]. The Jedi then took heavy casualties but ultimately defeated the Separatist forces on Geonosis.

==Biography==
Nicanas Tassu was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who earned the rank of [[Jedi Knight]] within the [[Jedi Order]]<ref name="SWFC" /> during the [[Republic Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AOTC" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Timelinse">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Jedi Knight [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured during the [[Separatist Crisis]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] and sentenced to public [[Death|execution]] in the [[Petranaki Arena]] there. With the aim of rescuing Kenobi, [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] led an [[Jedi assault team|assault team]] of 212 [[Jedi]], including Tassu, to Geonosis and they infiltrated the arena while Kenobi fought for his life within alongside his [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], who had also been captured.<ref name="AOTC" />

The Jedi then revealed themselves when Windu confronted the leader of the confederacy, [[Count]] [[Dooku]], and many descended to the arena floor, including Tassu. An [[Separatist Droid Army|army]] of [[battle droid]]s emerged to meet them in combat, but Tassu and fellow Knight [[Sephjet Josall]] sought out Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala, who were riding on a [[reek]] that they had taken control of. Tassu threw a spare [[lightsaber]] to the unarmed Skywalker while Jephet armed Kenobi. As the fighting continued, the Jedi took heavy casualties and eventually the survivors still fighting on the arena floor were rounded up and surrounded by the [[droid]]s, with neither Tassu or Josall among their number. Reinforcements then arrived in the form of a [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] that allowed the Jedi to turn the tide and defeat Dooku's forces.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Tassu had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and brown [[hair]]. During the Battle of Geonosis, his hair was beyond shoulder-length and he had a long, drooping moustache and goatee.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Tassu was notably skilled at [[Force jump]]ing, which he used to cross great lengths and at a quick speed. The Force jump aspiring Jedi [[Luke Skywalker]] performed on [[Cloud City]] to escape a [[carbon-freezing chamber]] was as fast and high as one of the Force leaps Tassu could perform.<ref name="Odyssey">''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
During the Battle of Geonosis, Tassu wore brown and tan [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] including a brown [[belt]] and used a green-bladed lightsaber. He provided a spare green-bladed lightsaber to Skywalker.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nicanas Tassu was portrayed by visual effects editor [[Nic Anastassiou]]<ref name="Insider77">{{InsiderCite|77|Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master}}</ref> in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The Jedi battle in the Geonosis Arena scenes were filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], between [[August 10]] and [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Tassu's name was used in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="SWFC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the [[Nicanas Tassu/Legends|character]] was first identified by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] in his "[[Star Wars Q&A|Ask the Master]]" column in the [[Star Wars Insider 77|seventy-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider77" /> which was published on [[August 3]], [[2004]].<ref name="Fan">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040713.html|text=Top Ten Trilogy Moments in ''Insider'' #77}}</ref> Hidalgo confirmed the name was based on Anastassiou's name.<ref name="Insider77" />
